raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.0.1"
  # dependencies
  lal_version: 8.0.0
  lalmetaio_version: 4.1.0
  lalsimulation_version: 7.0.0
  # LAL requires downstream packages to be built with the same version of SWIG,
  # so we need to pin it here
  swig_version: 4.4.1

recipe:
  name: lalburst-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/lalsuite/lalburst-${{ version }}.tar.xz
    sha256: 7f4923c32afb22882edd11d486aa7bd2728d5773fe7c3e8a47171fc2b9001578

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win

outputs:

  # -- Staging -----------------------

  - staging:
      name: lalburst-c-build
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - python >=3.6
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
      host:
        - gsl
        # pin LAL so that every platform builds against the same major version;
        # LAL 8 builds of the dependencies are not available for all variants
        - liblal ${{ lal_version }}.*
        - liblalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
        - liblalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}

  # -- Packages ----------------------

  - package:
      name: liblalburst
    inherit: lalburst-c-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - include/lal/
        - lib/liblalburst*
        - lib/pkgconfig/lalburst*.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalburst", upper_bound="x") }}
      run_constraints:
        - lalburst >=1.5.7
        - python-lalburst >=1.5.7
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - lalburst
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${PKG_VERSION}" lalburst
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Burst Library shared object libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Burst Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the shared-object libraries needed to run
        applications that use the LAL Burst library.

  - package:
      name: python-lalburst
    inherit:
      from: lalburst-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/
      script: build-python
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblalburst so that we ensure a unique
        # python-lalburst build string for each unique liblalburst build
        use_keys:
          - gsl
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - gsl
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalburst", exact=True) }}
        - lscsoft-glue
        - numpy
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - python-lalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
        - python-lalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
        - scipy
        - tqdm
      run:
        - igwn-ligolw >=2.1.0
        - igwn-segments
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalburst", exact=True) }}
        - lscsoft-glue
        - matplotlib-base
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - python-lalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
        - python-lalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
        - scipy
        - tqdm
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalburst
            - lalburst.SimBurstUtils
            - lalburst.SnglBurstUtils
            - lalburst.binjfind
            - lalburst.bucluster
            - lalburst.burca
            - lalburst.burca_tailor
            - lalburst.cafe
            - lalburst.calc_likelihood
            - lalburst.cs_gamma
            - lalburst.date
            - lalburst.offsetvector
            - lalburst.packing
            - lalburst.power
            - lalburst.snglcluster
            - lalburst.snglcoinc
            - lalburst.stringutils
            - lalburst.timeslides
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest >=4.0
        files:
          source:
            - test/python/
        script:
          - python -m pytest -ra -v test/python
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Burst Library Python bindings
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Burst Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the Python bindings of the LALBurst C libraries
        and additional Python modules.

        Note: this package only provides the importable Python libraries.
        All command-line interfaces, scripts, and executables are
        part of the `lalburst` package.

  - package:
      name: lalburst
    inherit:
      from: lalburst-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - bin/
        - etc/lalburst-user-env.*
        - share/man/
      script: build-bin
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblalburst so that we ensure a unique
        # lalburst build string for each unique liblalburst build
        use_keys:
          - gsl
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - rsync
        - sed
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalburst", exact=True) }}
        - liblal ${{ lal_version }}.*
        # needed by ./configure
        - numpy
        - python
        # help2man runs the Python scripts, which need their runtime dependencies
        - pillow
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalburst", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalburst", exact=True) }}
        - pillow
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalburst", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalburst
          pip_check: false
      - script:
          # assert that the manuals don't just contain errors
          - grep -q ModuleNotFoundError ${PREFIX}/share/man/man1/lalburst_*.1 && exit 1
          - cat "${PREFIX}/share/man/man1/lalburst_cluster.1" | head -n 20
          # check executables
          - lalburst_version --verbose
          - lalburst_cluster --help
          - lalburst_coinc --help
          - lalburst_cut --help
          - lalburst_gen_timeslides --help
          - lalburst_injfind --help
          - lalburst_inj_pic --help
          - lalburst_plot_tisi --help
          - lalburst_power_calc_likelihood --help
          - lalburst_power_final --help
          - lalburst_power_meas_likelihood --help
          - lalburst_power_plot_binj --help
          - lalburst_power_plot_binjtf --help
          # the user environment script rewrites PATH, so check that it still works
          - bash -c '. "${PREFIX}/etc/lalburst-user-env.sh" && lalburst_version'
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Burst Library
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Burst Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the runtime tools.
